capabilities: Convert CSV rows into notes with typed YAML properties
Preview an import before writing and undo the last one
Re-import a changed CSV while keeping edits made in notes
Show a CSV as a table with per-column type badges
Generate a base file for the imported notes
disambiguation: Not a general-purpose importer: it reads only CSV files and writes one note per row.
extras: Makes no network requests and collects no telemetry; import is one-way, so note changes are never written back to the CSV; interface is English only; requires Obsidian 1.15.1 or later.
intentEvidence: Competitor facts are taken from the plugins' own documentation and listings as read on 2026-11-23
problem: CSV data kept in a vault is plain text, so Bases and Dataview cannot sum, filter or sort it, and re-importing a changed file would overwrite edits made in the notes.

relations.evidence: Focus | CSV only | Many formats, including CSV

summary: Turns each row of a CSV file in the vault into a note with typed YAML properties, with a table view, import preview and undo.
